title: artemisia alba var. biasolettiana
intro: Artemisia alba var. biasolettiana, commonly known as White Mugwort, is a perennial herb belonging to the Asteraceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include treating digestive issues, menstrual cramps, and anxiety. The therapeutic actions of White Mugwort are attributed to its ability to stimulate digestion, relieve pain, and calm the nervous system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
